newsitem.title: USA: Spanlink Q3 gross profit margin on track.
newsitem.headline: Spanlink Q3 gross profit margin on track.

text.p: Spanlink Communications Inc Chief Executive Officer Brett Shockley said third-quarter results were in line with expectations.

"Third quarter revenue and gross profit margin were on track with our expectations," Shockley said in a statement. "Operating expenses were lower than planned, primarily due to a slower ramp-up in research and development expenses."

The company, which posted a quarterly loss of $0.15 per share compared to a year-ago profit of $0.04, said it had gross profit of $833,638, compared to $760,140 a year earlier. Revenues were $1.3 million, up from $1.1 million.
The company, which develops interactive computer telecommunications software, said it completed an initial public offering of 2,185,000 shares in May, raising net proceeds of about $7.6 million.
